libs.note: BH-3427 (BH-3422.2). mw_probe_run in bin/lib/model-watch-suggest.sh makes the one liveness probe of a newly seen vendor model through bin/agent-call.sh. The model-watch lane that sources the lib (a sibling BH-3422 slice) applies this row with lib_env_apply model-watch-suggest before it probes. Not required: the lib keeps 1 as its documented fallback, and a value that is not a number is refused with no call (D11).

knobs.zero_means: no probe: mw_probe_run answers not-run (probe disabled) with no PUT and no call
knobs.note: The per-call ceiling handed to agent-call as AGENT_CALL_BUDGET_USD_PROBE for the one probe call (a single reply of one word). It bounds that one call, not a daily or per-ticket spend; the dedup is the model_watch row's probe_attempted_at, read before any spend. Read as ${MODEL_WATCH_PROBE_USD_CAP:-0.25}.
